supplements.title: Artesunate reverses gefitinib resistance in lung adenocarcinoma by inducing ferroptosis and suppressing the Wnt/β-catenin pathway.
supplements.summary: Artesunate overcomes drug resistance in lung adenocarcinoma by triggering cancer cell death through ferroptosis and blocking a key growth pathway.

supplements.title: System Pharmacology-Based Anti-proliferation and Anti-angiogenesis Mechanisms of Oridonin in Psoriasis Keratinocytes by Blocking PI3K/AKT Signaling Pathway.
supplements.summary: Oridonin, a natural compound, stops psoriasis skin cell growth by blocking a key cellular signaling pathway.

supplements.title: In silico evaluation of selected triterpenes as potential inhibitors of BRAF and BRAFV600E kinases for cancer treatment.
supplements.summary: Computer modeling identifies four plant-derived triterpenes as potential new drugs to block BRAF mutations driving melanoma, thyroid, and colorectal cancers.

supplements.title: Kaempferol attenuates LPS-induced inflammatory responses in H9c2 cells through involvement of the IL-6/JAK2/STAT3 pathway.
supplements.summary: Kaempferol, a plant compound, reduces inflammation in heart cells by blocking a key signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Post-diagnostic Inflammatory and Insulinemic Diet and Lifestyle Patterns and Risk of Prostate Cancer-Specific Mortality in the Health Professionals Follow-up Study.
supplements.summary: Men with prostate cancer who followed inflammatory, high-sugar diets faced higher death risk from their cancer.

supplements.title: Biological and chemical investigation of metabolites from the marine sponge Geodia cydonium (Linnaeus, 1767) methanolic extract against melanoma cancer cell lines.
supplements.summary: Marine sponge extract and kynurenic acid show cytotoxic activity against melanoma cancer cells in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Protective effects of omega-3 supplements against ocular surface damage in circadian disruption rat model.
supplements.summary: Omega-3 supplements, especially fish oil, protect eye tissues from damage caused by disrupted sleep-wake cycles in rats.

supplements.title: (+)-Matairesinol, Derived From Olive Oil, Enhanced T-Cell Anti-Tumor Immune via JAK3-STAT1 Signal and Synergized With Anti-PD-1 Efficacy.
supplements.summary: Olive oil compound matairesinol boosts immune cells to kill triple-negative breast cancer and enhances anti-PD-1 immunotherapy effectiveness.

supplements.title: The Allium cepa Derived Compound Propyl Propane Thiosulfonate (PTSO) Improves Tumorigenesis Due to Its Immunomodulatory Effect: A Preclinical Study.
supplements.summary: An onion-derived compound (PTSO) reduced colorectal cancer tumors in mice by boosting immunity and restoring healthy gut bacteria.

supplements.title: Myricetin attenuates atrazine-induced dysregulation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis of rats via anti-oxidative, anti-inflammatory, and anti-apoptotic mechanisms.
supplements.summary: Myricetin protects rats' stress response systems from herbicide damage through antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.

supplements.title: Emodin Inhibitsg Hepatocellular Carcinoma Invasion and Migration by Regulating the HDAC4/NF-[Formula: see text]B (p65)/CXCL12 Signaling Axis and Suppressing M2 Macrophage Polarization.
supplements.summary: Emodin reduces liver cancer invasion and spread by blocking a pathway that promotes tumor-supporting immune cells.

supplements.title: [The effect of physiotherapy treatments on the immune system].
supplements.summary: Exercise and physiotherapy strengthen immune defenses against tumors by boosting natural killer cells and reducing inflammation.

supplements.title: Identification and validation of natural product-based KRASG12D inhibitors through structure-based virtual screening, molecular dynamics simulation, and in vitro studies.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified Rubimaillin, a natural compound, as a promising inhibitor of KRASG12D mutations in pancreatic cancer cells.

supplements.title: Resveratrol synergizes with chloroquine to inhibit the malignant progression of oral squamous cell carcinoma by regulating KIF11.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol and chloroquine together suppress oral squamous cell carcinoma growth by targeting the KIF11 protein.

supplements.title: Epigenetic Skin Aging and Its Reversal to Improve Skin Longevity across Ethnicities and Phototypes Using a Dihydromyricetin-Containing Serum: Results from a Prospective, Single-Cohort Study.
supplements.summary: A serum containing dihydromyricetin reversed skin aging markers across different ethnicities by targeting epigenetic changes.

off_label.title: Protein kinase Cι-driven macrophage infiltration mediates immunosuppression in non-small cell lung cancer.
off_label.summary: PKCι protein drives immune resistance in lung cancer by recruiting suppressive immune cells; blocking it restores immunotherapy effectiveness.

off_label.title: Pharmacological inhibition of histone deacetylase 6 and DNA damage repair enhances radiosensitivity in melanoma.
off_label.summary: Blocking HDAC6 protein with WT-161 makes melanoma more sensitive to radiation by impairing DNA damage repair.

off_label.title: Targeting the SIN1 mediated TTK/LDHA-H3K18la-GLUT3 axis disrupts metabolic-epigenetic crosstalk and suppresses progression in hyperglycolytic breast cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking the SIN1 protein disrupts a metabolic-epigenetic loop that fuels breast cancer growth and invasion, offering a potential new treatment strategy.

off_label.title: Resveratrol synergizes with chloroquine to inhibit the malignant progression of oral squamous cell carcinoma by regulating KIF11.
off_label.summary: Resveratrol and chloroquine together suppress oral squamous cell carcinoma growth by targeting the KIF11 protein.

off_label.title: Therapeutic Repurposing of Avanafil Against Lipopolysaccharide-induced Depression and Autoimmune Hepatitis: Gut-brain-liver Axis Orchestration Via Regulation of TLR4/NF-κB/IDO and Nrf2/HO-1 Pathways.
off_label.summary: Avanafil, a erectile dysfunction drug, reduced inflammation and improved depression-like symptoms and liver function in inflamed rats by restoring gut barrier integrity.

off_label.title: Interleukin-1α (IL-1α) in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma: implications for immunotherapy and molecular biomarkers.
off_label.summary: High IL-1α expression predicts poor pancreatic cancer outcomes and blocking it with drugs like anakinra combined with immunotherapy improves treatment response.

off_label.title: Renoprotective effects of perampanel against cisplatin-induced acute kidney injury: managing NLRP3-pyroptosis and enhancement of antioxidant defense.
off_label.summary: Perampanel, an anti-seizure drug, protects kidneys from cisplatin chemotherapy damage by reducing inflammation and boosting antioxidant defenses in rats.

off_label.title: The anticancer properties of dexmedetomidine in papillary thyroid cancer and its underlying mechanisms.
off_label.summary: Dexmedetomidine inhibits papillary thyroid cancer cell growth by activating p38 MAPK and suppressing PI3K/Akt signaling pathways.

off_label.title: Targeting SRC enhances differentiation and promotes multifaceted cell death mechanisms in recurrent group 3 medulloblastoma.
off_label.summary: Blocking SRC protein in aggressive childhood brain tumors (Group 3 medulloblastoma) kills cancer cells and prevents treatment resistance without harming healthy brain tissue.

off_label.title: CK1α agonists attenuate medulloblastoma stemness and relapse risk.
off_label.summary: A drug that activates CK1α reduces stem cell populations and relapse risk in aggressive medulloblastoma models.

off_label.title: Topical delivery of Vismodegib using fourth-generation PAMAM dendrimers: a potential treatment for Kaposi's sarcoma.
off_label.summary: Dendrimer nanoparticles effectively deliver Vismodegib through skin to kill Kaposi's sarcoma cancer cells in laboratory tests.

off_label.title: Nebivolol suppresses glioblastoma progression via dual modulation of mitochondrial metabolism and AKT/mTOR/4EBP1 signaling axis.
off_label.summary: Nebivolol, a heart drug, slows glioblastoma growth by disrupting mitochondrial energy and blocking cancer cell signaling pathways.

off_label.title: Phase Ib Randomized Study of Gemcitabine (G) With Nab-paclitaxel With or Without Pitavastatin (P) in the Maintenance Treatment of Unresectable Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma (uPDAC)
off_label.summary: A study testing whether adding pitavastatin to standard chemotherapy improves maintenance treatment outcomes for unresectable pancreatic cancer.

off_label.title: A Pilot Study of Losartan to Reduce Radiation Induced Fibrosis in Breast Cancer Patients
off_label.summary: Researchers are testing whether losartan, an existing blood pressure drug, can reduce scarring in breast tissue after radiation therapy in breast cancer patients.

off_label.title: Association between statin use and the risk of colorectal, liver, and lung cancers: a population-based retrospective cohort study.
off_label.summary: Researchers studied whether statins reduce the risk of colorectal, liver, and lung cancers in a large population group.

biomarkers.title: Analysis of the circRNA/lncRNA-miRNA-mRNA Networks of Action of Fire Needle Acupuncture in Relieving Chemotherapy-Induced Neuropathic Pain.
biomarkers.summary: Fire needle acupuncture may relieve chemotherapy-induced nerve pain through specific molecular pathways, offering a potential treatment alternative.

biomarkers.title: Cost-effectiveness analysis of lorlatinib as first-line treatment for anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK)-positive non-small cell lung cancer in Italy.
biomarkers.summary: Lorlatinib proves cost-effective as first-line treatment for ALK-positive lung cancer compared to alectinib in Italy's healthcare system.

biomarkers.title: RTA‑408 induces p38‑dependent apoptosis and suppresses cell viability in hepatocellular carcinoma cells.
biomarkers.summary: RTA-408 kills hepatocellular carcinoma cells by triggering a protein called p38 to activate cell death pathways.

biomarkers.title: Mutations in CHIP-associated genes at myeloid neoplasm diagnosis and risk of cardiovascular/cerebrovascular events.
biomarkers.summary: Certain blood cancer mutations detected at diagnosis may increase patients' risk of heart attacks and strokes.

biomarkers.title: Importin α characterizes a micronuclear environment associated with genomic instability in human cancer cells.
biomarkers.summary: Importin α protein accumulates in specific micronuclei and marks regions excluded from DNA repair, revealing how cancer cells develop genomic instability.

biomarkers.title: Important Role of Ultrasound in Assessing Tubulocystic Renal Cell Carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Ultrasound effectively identifies tubulocystic renal cell carcinoma as hyperechoic lesions, helping distinguish this rare kidney cancer from benign cysts.

biomarkers.title: Scrib organizes cortical actomyosin clusters to maintain adherens junctions and angiogenic sprouting.
biomarkers.summary: Scrib protein organizes muscle clusters at cell junctions to strengthen blood vessel growth and stability during angiogenesis.

biomarkers.title: AID and TET2 cooperate to demethylate Irf4 for plasma cell fate in germinal center B cells.
biomarkers.summary: AID and TET2 proteins work together to activate a gene that enables B cells to transform into antibody-producing plasma cells.

biomarkers.title: m6A-modified circFOXA1 promotes tumor immune evasion via enhancing PD-L1 deubiquitination in triple-negative breast cancer.
biomarkers.summary: A circular RNA called circFOXA1 helps triple-negative breast cancer evade the immune system by stabilizing a protein that suppresses immune cells.

biomarkers.title: TM4SF1 regulates esophageal squamous cell carcinoma KYSE150 cell phenotypes via miRNA-regulated pathways.
biomarkers.summary: TM4SF1 protein promotes esophageal squamous cell carcinoma growth; blocking it reduces cell proliferation and increases cancer cell death.

biomarkers.title: Nuclear receptor subfamily 2 group F member 2 transcriptionally activates 14-3-3 epsilon to promote diffuse large B-cell lymphoma progression.
biomarkers.summary: NR2F2 protein promotes diffuse large B-cell lymphoma progression by activating a gene that triggers cancer cell growth signaling.

biomarkers.title: Antiretroviral therapy blocks natural selection on protective and disease-susceptible HLA-B alleles in HIV-1 infection.
biomarkers.summary: Antiretroviral therapy stops HIV from naturally selecting certain protective immune genes in African populations.

biomarkers.title: Antenatal Presentation of MRPS22-Related Mitochondrial Disease Confirmed With Rapid Proteomics.
biomarkers.summary: Rapid proteomics confirmed MRPS22 gene mutations causing severe fetal mitochondrial disease with multiple birth defects.

biomarkers.title: Tall Cell Carcinoma of the Breast With Reverse Polarity: Expanding the Molecular Spectrum With IDH1 R132 Mutation.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified a rare breast cancer type with a novel IDH1 mutation, treated successfully with surgery and hormone therapy.

biomarkers.title: Optimal Adjuvant Therapy Selection for Chinese BRAF V600-Mutant Stage III Melanoma: A Multicenter Efficacy Comparison of Targeted Agents, Immunotherapy, and Combinatorial Strategies.
biomarkers.summary: For Chinese patients with stage III BRAF-mutant melanoma, combined BRAF/MEK targeted therapy significantly improved survival compared to other adjuvant treatments.

trials.title: Yoga for Patients Undergoing Thoracic Radiotherapy and Their Family Caregivers: Results of a Randomized Controlled Trial.
trials.summary: Yoga involving thoracic cancer patients and their family caregivers improved quality of life better than education alone during radiotherapy treatment.

trials.title: Cost-effectiveness analysis of lorlatinib as first-line treatment for anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK)-positive non-small cell lung cancer in Italy.
trials.summary: Lorlatinib proves cost-effective as first-line treatment for ALK-positive lung cancer compared to alectinib in Italy's healthcare system.

trials.title: Prevalence and clinical impact of hepatic steatosis on autoimmune liver disease: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Fat accumulation in livers of autoimmune liver disease patients is common but its clinical effects need further research.

trials.title: Tall Cell Carcinoma of the Breast With Reverse Polarity: Expanding the Molecular Spectrum With IDH1 R132 Mutation.
trials.summary: Researchers identified a rare breast cancer type with a novel IDH1 mutation, treated successfully with surgery and hormone therapy.

trials.title: Optimal Adjuvant Therapy Selection for Chinese BRAF V600-Mutant Stage III Melanoma: A Multicenter Efficacy Comparison of Targeted Agents, Immunotherapy, and Combinatorial Strategies.
trials.summary: For Chinese patients with stage III BRAF-mutant melanoma, combined BRAF/MEK targeted therapy significantly improved survival compared to other adjuvant treatments.

trials.title: Paradoxical Efficacy With Rare Adverse Events: Sequential ALK Inhibitor Therapy in Lung Adenocarcinoma.
trials.summary: ALK inhibitors effectively shrink lung adenocarcinoma tumors but can cause rare, severe side effects like lung inflammation and skin toxicity requiring careful monitoring.

trials.title: Management of immune-related dermatologic toxicities in cancer patients receiving PD-1/PD-L1 blockade: a best practice implementation project.
trials.summary: Immunotherapy drugs cause skin problems in 30% of cancer patients, requiring better management strategies to prevent treatment interruption.

trials.title: The histone-modified landscape: Core mechanisms of osimertinib resistance in EGFR-mutant lung cancer.
trials.summary: Histone modifications drive osimertinib resistance in EGFR-mutant lung cancer, offering new biomarkers and therapeutic targets.

trials.title: Protein kinase Cι-driven macrophage infiltration mediates immunosuppression in non-small cell lung cancer.
trials.summary: PKCι protein drives immune resistance in lung cancer by recruiting suppressive immune cells; blocking it restores immunotherapy effectiveness.

trials.title: Prognostic significance of HLA-B leader matching status and its relationship with NK cell reconstitution in patients with hematological malignancies following haploidentical transplantation.
trials.summary: HLA-B leader matching improves survival and NK cell recovery in myeloid cancer patients undergoing haploidentical stem cell transplantation.

trials.title: MAP4K4 regulates the immune landscape of pancreatic tumor microenvironment and provides an opportunity for immunotherapy.
trials.summary: Blocking MAP4K4 in pancreatic cancer reduces immune-suppressing cells and, combined with immunotherapy, boosts cancer-fighting T cells and tumor shrinkage.

trials.title: SNHG18 deficiency reprograms arginine metabolism to foster an immunosuppressive microenvironment in prostate cancer bone metastasis.
trials.summary: Low SNHG18 levels in prostate cancer bone metastasis promote an immunosuppressive environment by altering arginine metabolism, reducing immunotherapy effectiveness.

trials.title: An indirect comparison of zanubrutinib vs acalabrutinib plus venetoclax in patients with treatment-naive CLL.
trials.summary: Zanubrutinib monotherapy showed superior progression-free survival compared to acalabrutinib-venetoclax combination in treatment-naive chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

trials.title: Baseline IPSS-M vs pretransplant risk downstaging as prognostic determinants in MDS undergoing allogeneic transplantation.
trials.summary: Baseline risk assessment at MDS diagnosis predicts transplant outcomes better than reassessment after treatment, challenging the value of risk downstaging.

trials.title: Targeting the DDX3/PAF1 axis enhances chemotherapy efficacy in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
trials.summary: Blocking the DDX3/PAF1 axis with RK-33 enhances chemotherapy effectiveness in pancreatic cancer when combined with standard drugs.

mind_body.title: Yoga for Patients Undergoing Thoracic Radiotherapy and Their Family Caregivers: Results of a Randomized Controlled Trial.
mind_body.summary: Yoga involving thoracic cancer patients and their family caregivers improved quality of life better than education alone during radiotherapy treatment.

mind_body.title: Attitudes, Practices, and Barriers to Spiritual Care for Patients With Cancer: An International Survey.
mind_body.summary: Oncology clinicians recognize spiritual care as important but face significant barriers to providing it to cancer patients in practice.

mind_body.title: Analysis of the circRNA/lncRNA-miRNA-mRNA Networks of Action of Fire Needle Acupuncture in Relieving Chemotherapy-Induced Neuropathic Pain.
mind_body.summary: Fire needle acupuncture may relieve chemotherapy-induced nerve pain through specific molecular pathways, offering a potential treatment alternative.

mind_body.title: Social prescribing for people recovering from treatment for cancer: a systematic scoping review.
mind_body.summary: Social prescribing—connecting cancer survivors with community activities—helps address emotional and social challenges during recovery.

mind_body.title: Exploring psychosocial outcomes of fly-fishing retreats for cancer survivors: A qualitative study.
mind_body.summary: Fly-fishing retreats help cancer survivors improve their wellbeing through nature-based activities and social connection.

mind_body.title: A mixed-methods longitudinal study of demoralization and depression in breast cancer survivors.
mind_body.summary: Breast cancer survivors commonly experience demoralization and depression after treatment, conditions that warrant separate clinical attention and further study.

mind_body.title: [The effect of physiotherapy treatments on the immune system].
mind_body.summary: Exercise and physiotherapy strengthen immune defenses against tumors by boosting natural killer cells and reducing inflammation.

mind_body.title: Treatment of neuropathic pain in cancer survivors: a scoping review of pharmacological, exercise, and psychosocial interventions.
mind_body.summary: Cancer survivors can manage neuropathic pain through medications, exercise, and psychological treatments, according to a comprehensive research review.

mind_body.title: [Moxibustion enhances the antitumor efficacy of Trametinib in breast cancer-bearing mice via MEK/ERK signaling pathway].
mind_body.summary: Moxibustion combined with Trametinib drug treatment more effectively slows breast cancer growth in mice than either treatment alone.

mind_body.title: [Effect of electroacupuncture on microglial polarization and activity of α7nAChR-TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB signaling pathway in the anterior cingulate cortex of rats with chronic inflammatory pain-depression comorbidity].
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture reduces pain and depression in rats by changing how brain immune cells respond through a specific cellular pathway.

mind_body.title: Feasibility and acceptability of a stress-management behavioral weight loss intervention for Black breast cancer survivors.
mind_body.summary: A stress management weight loss program for Black breast cancer survivors proved feasible, acceptable, and achieved significant weight loss and stress reduction.

mind_body.title: Online self-compassion-based interventions on patient outcomes in patients with cancer: a systematic review.
mind_body.summary: Online self-compassion programs may improve outcomes for cancer patients, though more research is needed to confirm effectiveness.

mind_body.title: Pregnancy experiences of expectant parents with Neurofibromatosis type 1: a qualitative interview study.
mind_body.summary: Expectant parents with Neurofibromatosis type 1 experience anxiety and emotional uncertainty during pregnancy, requiring tailored psychological support to strengthen bonding.

mind_body.title: Five-year longitudinal changes in social, economic, and psychosocial wellbeing among young women with breast cancer in Mexico.
mind_body.summary: Young breast cancer survivors in Mexico experience significant long-term challenges across work, relationships, finances, and mental health over five years.

mind_body.title: Use of Transcranial Photobiomodulation to Improve Cognition and Self-Reported Outcomes in Survivors of Childhood Cancer
mind_body.summary: A study tests whether home-based light therapy combined with cognitive training improves thinking skills in childhood cancer survivors.
